searchText: I made a PR which adds an initial docusaurus page with all the old mds moved over. As I am reading through your past hackMDs I was also planning on adding them to that repo if you think it'd be helpful? Hi, Thanks for the PR. Currently if changes are made to the repo and pushed, it will compile and re-deploy the website, can you modify the CI workflow to do this for docusaurus? RE the HackMd's, it would be good to have that information there, I'll revisit issue #2 re structure of the website (not 100% satisfied with it) and we can add them in a separate PR. Feel free to opine on what you think would make a good structure for those who have no experience with verkle tries, even broadly. We can start off by looking at the ethereum.org docs here : <https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/> to see what categories are included and the structure that was chosen (It may or may not be suitable for us)

excerpts.author: controlcthenv
excerpts.content: I made a PR which adds an initial docusaurus page with all the old mds moved over. As I am reading through your past hackMDs I was also planning on adding them to that repo if you think it'd be helpful?

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
Hi,

Thanks for the PR. Currently if changes are made to the repo and pushed, it will compile and re-deploy the website, can you modify the CI workflow to do this for docusaurus?

RE the HackMd's, it would be good to have that information there, I'll revisit issue #2 re structure of the website (not 100% satisfied with it) and we can add them in a separate PR. Feel free to opine on what you think would make a good structure for those who have no experience with verkle tries, even broadly. 

We can start off by looking at the ethereum.org docs here : <https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/> to see what categories are included and the structure that was chosen (It may or may not be suitable for us)
